description: A bounded mutation-and-benchmark run. The run may propose code or prompt changes, but promotion is a separate decision backed by deterministic benchmarks and Git history; no run grants authority or installs itself.

run.worktree: Relative path under the node state directory. It must not be a vault path or a protected path.
run.mutation_sha256: 64 lowercase hex characters over the candidate diff.
run.thresholds: The fixed pass/fail thresholds recorded before the run; a post-hoc threshold is refused.
run.decision: promote only when every threshold passes; otherwise rollback.
run.signature_b64: Optional Ed25519 signature over the run record. It proves provenance, not authority.

benchmark.suite: A named, versioned, deterministic suite; randomness and network calls are excluded.
benchmark.report: One record per metric with baseline, candidate, delta and threshold; a missing metric refuses promotion.

promotion.action: Commit the candidate to Git, then fast-forward the managed branch.
promotion.rollback: Hard reset to base_commit and remove the worktree; no partial merge.

fallback.when: Firecracker or KVM is unavailable on the host
fallback.note: The worktree/container fallback is recorded in the run as mode=worktree; it is not presented as a microVM run.

rules: A run is data and a proposal, never authority.
No threshold change after the run starts.
A failed or cancelled run leaves the managed branch at base_commit.
